title: RCF EVAL
description: One file per EVAL. Grades the observable output of one or more nonDeterministic Acceptance Criteria on the User Story identified by usId. EVAL is a peer of a Test Suite: TS/TC verify deterministic behaviour, EVAL grades non-deterministic behaviour (LLM-generated text, ranked results, generated code, judgement calls). EVAL is optional in the chain; it is required only for ACs marked determinism: nonDeterministic. The document holds the case set, the judge configuration, the pass threshold, and an append-only runRecord[] of graded runs. runRecord entries are authored by whichever runner produced them (project runner, verify's later --with-eval extension, or a hand-written entry). Running an EVAL is not a schema concern; the schema is the shape the runner produces and the coverage audit reads.

acIds.description: ACs this EVAL grades. All ACs must live on the parent US (cross-US coverage is not permitted at v1; the AC-to-EVAL binding is scoped by the parent US the same way TS is).

purpose.description: Multi-sentence rationale. What non-deterministic behaviour is being graded, and why the criteria set is the right one.

criteria.description: Rubric criteria. Each criterion is a graded axis (correctness, tone, safety, latency, and so on) with an optional critical flag and a weight.

cases.description: Graded examples. A case is not a TC in the test-runner sense; TCs count executions of code paths, EVAL cases count graded outputs.

runRecord.description: Append-only history of graded runs. The most recent entry is the one the merge gate reads for EVAL-BELOW-THRESHOLD. Absent or empty means no run has landed yet (audit reports the EVAL as pending).

id.description: Kebab-slug identifier, unique within the EVAL.

description.description: One-line prose describing what this criterion grades.

critical.description: When true, a case that fails this criterion fails the whole run even if the aggregate score would otherwise pass. Optional; defaults to false at consumer level.

weight.description: Positive weight for aggregate scoring under llmJudge and scriptedMetric. Optional; defaults to 1 at consumer level. Unused when judge.type is rubric and every criterion is boolean.

id.description: Kebab-slug identifier, unique within the EVAL.

input.description: Free-shape JSON. The inputs the AC's system-under-test receives on this case.

expected.description: Free-shape JSON. The reference output where one exists. Optional; many non-deterministic cases have no single reference.

criteriaIds.description: Subset of criteria[].id this case should be graded against. Empty array or omission means all criteria.

notes.description: Free text; case-specific guidance for the judge to consume.

type.description: How this EVAL scores its cases. rubric: deterministic scoring against declared boolean criteria, no external process. llmJudge: spawn the subscription-authenticated LLM CLI (claude on PATH), capture structured JSON on stdout, validate against declared response schema. scriptedMetric: run a project-owned executable whose stdout is a scored JSON envelope.

invoker.description: Bin name on PATH. Estate rule: subscription-only. The verify launcher already uses the same pattern (spawn claude by bare name; no API keys enter rcf-lite). codex is included for consumers on the codex CLI leg of the subscription-only rule; the enum can grow additively when the estate expands.

modelHint.description: Optional model hint passed through to the CLI when the underlying CLI supports a model flag. Falls back to the CLI's default; the fallback is logged in the runRecord[] entry's notes.

systemPromptPath.description: Path relative to project root of the system prompt used for grading. Project-owned, git-tracked.

responseSchemaPath.description: Path relative to project root of the JSON schema the judge is required to return. Fields declared here are the per-criterion score (0..1), per-criterion rationale, and boolean flags for critical criteria.

command.description: argv for the scoring process. First entry is the executable; remaining entries are arguments. Runner spawns this per case with the case payload on stdin.

responseSchemaPath.description: Path relative to project root of the JSON schema stdout must satisfy. A scored JSON envelope with per-criterion score and rationale.

aggregateScore.description: Minimum weighted aggregate score (0..1) across cases for a run to be counted a pass.

criticalMustPass.description: When true, any critical criterion failing on any case fails the run even if aggregateScore is met. Optional; consumers default to true.

minCasesPassing.description: Optional floor on how many cases must fully pass (all criteria met, no critical failure). Absent means no case-count floor is enforced.

runId.description: Unique identifier for this graded run. Free-form (project convention); runners commonly use an ISO timestamp plus a short suffix.

runner.description: Free-form identifier for what produced the record (for example, claude-cli:0.1.28, rcf-lite:0.17.0, hand-authored).

modelPinned.description: Optional. Model pin captured at run time (relevant for llmJudge runs). Records the invoker-resolved model when a modelHint was passed and the CLI reported the resolution.

aggregateScore.description: Weighted aggregate across cases (0..1) for this run.

criticalFailures.description: Criterion ids that failed a critical check on at least one case. Empty means no critical failures.

perCaseScores.description: Optional per-case detail. Absent for compact records; present for full grading detail.

verdict.description: Overall verdict for this run. pending is used when a run is recorded but grading is not yet complete; the coverage audit treats pending as absent for resolving-EVAL purposes.

artefactPointer.description: Optional pointer to a raw-judge-output artefact on disk. Path is relative to project root. Consumers do not read the pointed file at coverage time; it is retained for post-hoc review.

notes.description: Free text; used by runners to record fallbacks (for example, modelHint not honoured by the invoker) or operator context.

caseId.description: The case id this score belongs to.

criteriaScores.description: Optional per-criterion breakdown for this case.

criticalFailed.description: Criterion ids that failed a critical check on this case.

rationale.description: Judge-authored rationale for this criterion score on this case.
